summary: Second half of the false-breakout (假突破) short-entry chapter: four case studies (正峰新 daily+weekly 2011, 晟铭电 daily 2011, 晶电 daily+weekly 2010-2011, 微软 monthly 1993-2011). A breakout to new highs (often on heavy volume) that falls back below the breakout candle's low or the broken neckline within a few days confirms a false breakout and a short entry; the downside target is then measured with the equal-distance method (prior swing high minus the latest swing low, subtracted from the rebound high once the prior low breaks). The unit also teaches chip/margin structure (价涨券增 = retail shorting into strength, 价跌券增 = main-player shorting), 'short weak, not strong' (空弱不空强), and on long-term charts uses 假突破 to exit and 破底翻 to re-enter.

patterns.name_en: False breakout above a range/neckline (short entry)
patterns.structure: After a big rise, price consolidates, then breaks above the range high/neckline to a new high, often on a heavy-volume long red (bullish) candle (带量长红). Within ~3 trading days it falls back below that breakout candle's low and/or back under the broken neckline, or the breakout day itself turns into a heavy-volume black candle (带量翻黑).
patterns.entry: Short when price breaks the low of the heavy-volume breakout candle (e.g. 正峰新 6/2 long red, broken within 3 days → short ~52.8; 晟铭电 6/13 breaks the 6/1 long-red low 59.9) or when a heavy-volume black candle breaks back below the line (晶电 4/19 带量翻黑破线 → short ~95.5). Later flat-open days can also be used to sell short (晟铭电 6/14-15, highs 58.8).
patterns.stop: The false-breakout high (正峰新 56.5, risk ~7%), or price closing back above the broken line/neckline (晟铭电 ~61.5, ~6%; 晶电 99.5 '站回线上', ~4.2%). Add-on shorts on a later break of a prior low get their own stop at a reclaim of the line (晶电 add 75, stop 79, ~5.3%).

target.formula: Equal-distance decline (等幅跌幅满足): once price breaks the latest rebound low L, target = rebound high H2 - (prior top H1 - L). With a head-and-shoulders-like top: target = neckline break level - (mid of the two highs - neckline).

confirmation: Breakout failure within about 3 trading days (正峰新 6/2, 晶电 3/8 '三个交易日内便跌破大量低点').
Heavy volume without further rise (大量不涨) on the breakout bar.
Heavy-volume black candle breaking the line (带量翻黑破线) confirms the top.
Chip data: inventory balance (库存余额) falling = main player distributing; 价跌券增 after distribution = main-player short structure.
Large prior gain (e.g. >200%-300%) makes a false breakout a high-risk distribution signal.
invalidation: Price closes back above the broken line/neckline or above the false-breakout high (stop).
Stocks still making new highs are strong; do not short them (空弱不空强).

patterns.structure: Weekly chart: a rise from low L1 to high H1, a pullback to low L2, then a breakout above H1 (here a short-squeeze gap, 轧空突破前高).
patterns.entry: Buy in the week of the heavy-volume breakout above the neckline (正峰新 2011-03-12 week, ~39).
patterns.stop: A break back below the neckline (37, about 5% risk).
confirmation: Heavy-volume long red weekly candle breaking the neckline; neckline support ~38 holds.

patterns.name_en: Break-bottom reversal as a long-term bottoming signal
patterns.structure: Monthly chart: price breaks below a long-term neckline/support and makes a new low, then a few months later climbs back above the neckline.
patterns.entry: Re-enter after the reclaim of the neckline (微软 2009-06 reclaimed the line about 3 months after the 2009-03 low of 14.87) and set a stop.
patterns.stop: The book only says '设好停损'; the neckline support it names is ~21 USD.
confirmation: Price holds above the neckline support (~21 USD) for years afterwards.
invalidation: Not stated explicitly; by the framework, falling back below the neckline.

rules.rule: A heavy-volume breakout to a new high that turns into a heavy-volume black candle (带量翻黑) confirms a false breakout and a sell signal.
rules.quote_zh: 2011年4月8日轧至新高随后出现带量翻黑，假突破确立的卖出信号。

rules.rule: A heavy-volume long red candle that breaks the range high but is broken below its own low within 3 days is also a false breakout (the main player's last fake-out before a collapse).
rules.quote_zh: 同年6月2日带量长红隔日高点56.5元突破整理区高点56.1元，但3日内便跌破长红低点也是属于假突破，股价在主力做最后骗线后随之崩盘。

rules.rule: 价涨券增 (price up, short interest up) is usually retail shorting into strength and invites a short squeeze by the main player.
rules.quote_zh: 价涨券增，通常是散户往上放空的结构，容易引起主力轧空。

rules.rule: Short weak, not strong: a stock making new highs is strong; if wrong, accept the stop; never add to shorts or short strong stocks; wait for a weakening signal such as a confirmed false breakout.
rules.quote_zh: 切记，放空的技巧是空弱不空强，会创新高的股票就是强势股，做错就认输停损，不应加码放空或建立强势股空单，需待有转弱现象出现时才是做空时机（如假突破确立）。

rules.rule: If the inventory balance (库存余额) drops sharply near neckline support, the main player is unloading into dip-buyers in the neckline zone; know the chip structure to avoid this trap.
rules.quote_zh: 库存余额急降，显示主力利用颈线支撑积极作量倒货……洞悉筹码结构，便能避开主力在高档区颈线压低出货陷阱。

rules.rule: After distribution, 价跌券增 (price down, short interest up) is a main-player short structure; a low-volume rebound that only reaches the lower edge of the broken neckline zone is weak (support turned resistance).
rules.quote_zh: 价跌券增属主力放空结构，9至10月的反弹最高33.5元，仅碰触上述33至40元颈线区下缘属弱势反弹（支撑跌破变反压），期间无量，便是主力出货后呈无主力状态

rules.rule: Weekly upside measured move: once price breaks the prior high, target = pullback low + (prior high - starting low).
rules.quote_zh: 自24.85元低点+32.57元=等幅计算的涨幅满足57.42元附近。

rules.rule: While the neckline support holds after a heavy-volume breakout, keep targeting the measured move.
rules.quote_zh: 技术面3月12日周线带量长红，突破颈线的颈线支撑38元附近不破，看涨幅满足57.42元附近。

rules.rule: After the target is reached, a heavy-volume black candle breaking the line confirms the top and starts a long downtrend.
rules.quote_zh: 同年6月25日周线带量翻黑破线，头部确立，就此进入长空

rules.rule: Market moves are often man-made speculation and leave traces; they are not coincidence.
rules.quote_zh: 投资市场常常是人为的投机，有迹可循，并非巧合。

rules.rule: Downside measured move from a top: target = neckline-break level - (mid of the two highs - neckline).
rules.quote_zh: 两个高点中间值约57.5元，至颈线约在34.7元距离约22.8元；7月13日长黑跌破颈线的位置约在36.5元-22.8元=等幅计算的跌幅满足13.7元

rules.rule: A false breakout is often a main-player fake-out: let the market get used to the price during a consolidation, then push volume up to draw retail in.
rules.quote_zh: 由此可知假突破经常是主力骗线的一种手法，利用一段时间的整理，让市场习惯股价后，再作量转强让市场尤其是散户跟进。

rules.rule: After a large cumulative gain (~300%), a false breakout confirms distribution and is the highest-risk point and the best short opportunity; don't buy deep-dip rebounds in such stocks.
rules.quote_zh: 因此出现假突破后表示主力拉高骗线出货确立，便是风险最高的时候，也是喜好做空者最佳放空时机，此类股切忌跌深抢反弹

rules.rule: The time to short is when the price turns weak.
rules.quote_zh: 做空的技巧就在股价转弱时。

rules.rule: Stop for the false-breakout short: price back above the broken neckline (~61.5), which keeps risk limited (~6%).
rules.quote_zh: 停损设在突破颈线约61.5元时风险有限，约6%。

rules.rule: Practical: margin shorts are force-covered at the ex-dividend date; re-short when margin shorting resumes.
rules.quote_zh: 需注意6月30日除权息融券强迫回补后，7月6日恢复融券将回补的筹码再空即可。

rules.rule: The downside target is computed once price breaks the rebound low: (top - rebound low) subtracted from the rebound high; adjust for dividends if needed.
rules.quote_zh: 7月11日跌破反弹低点41.9元，便可计算跌幅满足。自66.5元高点至41.9元低点，共跌24.6元。自48元高点-24.6元=等幅跌幅满足23.4元（通常需填权息计算则在23.8元附近）

rules.rule: Take the short swing profit when price consolidates near the target.
rules.quote_zh: 股价8月下旬达跌幅满足附近整理，便是空单波段获利时，约58%。

rules.rule: Heavy volume without a rise (大量不涨): a heavy-volume neckline breakout that breaks the heavy-volume bar's low within three days and falls back under the neckline is a false-breakout sell signal.
rules.quote_zh: 晶电2011年3月8日带量突破颈线，三个交易日内便跌破大量低点，随后更是跌回颈线以下，确立大量不涨的假突破卖出信号

rules.rule: Each new break of a prior low allows a fresh measured-move target (cascade of targets).
rules.quote_zh: 8月2日跌破前低65.15元后，也可计算跌幅满足。自88.24元高点至65.15元低点，共跌23.09元。自70.64元高点-23.09元=等幅计算的跌幅满足47.55元。

rules.rule: Short on the heavy-volume black candle breaking the line, stop on a reclaim of the line; add on a break of the prior low with a stop on a reclaim of the line.
rules.quote_zh: 约可空在95.5元停损设99.5元，也就是站回线上时，风险约4.2%，7月8日破线跌破前低空单加码，约可空在75元，停损设79元，也就是站回线上时，风险约5.3%

rules.rule: Multi-timeframe: the weekly false breakout (black candle breaking the heavy-volume low) lines up with the daily false breakout and marks a long-term sell signal.
rules.quote_zh: 晶电周线跌破大量低点假突破确立长线卖出信号的位置，便是对应上述日线同期假突破的位置

rules.rule: Volume-price structure reflects fundamentals; lower highs and lower lows after a false breakout mean a long bear phase.
rules.quote_zh: 量价结构反应基本面的情况……也在假突破后结束再陷长空格局，高点与低点皆越来越低反映了产业窘境。

rules.rule: Long-term: falling back below a broken neckline is a long-term sell signal (假突破).
rules.quote_zh: 6年多的大多头行情在2000年2月跌回突破的颈线以下，确立了长线卖出信号“假突破”

rules.rule: Even the best industry can't escape the business cycle; on long-term charts, 假突破 and 破底翻 tell you when the cycle turns: take profits on a false breakout and wait for a 破底翻-type bottoming signal before re-entering with a stop.
rules.quote_zh: 只是再好的产业都逃不过景气循环，时间长短的问题而已，长线技术面假突破及破底翻是较精确掌握景气是否反转的判断方式，当出现假突破信号时长线便应见好就收，等待类似破底翻的企稳信号，才做介入设好停损等待。

rules.rule: Master quote (Livermore): it took five years to learn to play the market sensibly.
rules.quote_zh: 我花了整整五年的时间才觉得自己能理智地玩炒股游戏。

worked_examples.outcome: 6/2 long-red breakout failed within 3 days → short; 7/13 long black candle broke the neckline; reached the target, short profit ≈74%; price later fell below the 10 par value

worked_examples.pattern: 涨幅满足 then 带量翻黑破线 top
worked_examples.outcome: Breakout week 2011-03-12; reached the target (high 58), long profit ≈47%; 2011-06-25 heavy-volume black weekly candle broke the line → long bear
Reached the target in late August, short swing profit ≈58%; kept falling to 18.2 on 2011-12-09

worked_examples.pattern: 大量不涨假突破 → 带量翻黑破线 → cascading 跌幅满足
worked_examples.outcome: Top confirmed 2011-04-19; reached the targets, short profit ≈25%-50%; rebounded ~70% from 47.09, then broke to new lows a year later

worked_examples.pattern: 周线假突破 (翻黑跌破大量低点)
worked_examples.outcome: Weekly false breakout = long-term sell signal, aligned with the daily one; the rebound to 82.41 ended in another false breakout and new lows

worked_examples.pattern: 假突破 ×2 then 破底翻
worked_examples.outcome: 2000-02 fell back below the neckline → long-term sell; 2007-10 breakout failed within ~4 months → second sell; 2009-06 破底翻 reclaim → long-term bottom; held above ~21 for 3+ years

quantifiable: False breakout (short): bar B closes above the N-bar range high with volume > k × average volume; within 3 bars a close below low(B) → short signal; stop = max(high since B) or a close back above the range high.
Variant: on a breakout day close < open with heavy volume (带量翻黑) and a close back below the line → short.
Downside measured move: after the top H1 and rebound low L1, a later rebound high H2 < H1; when close < L1, target = H2 - (H1 - L1). Repeat on each new prior-low break.
Head-type measure: target = neckline_break_price - (mean(two highs) - neckline).
Upside measured move: after a close above the prior high H1, target = L2 + (H1 - L1), where L1 is the starting low and L2 the pullback low.
Risk filter: skip a stop that implies more than ~7% risk, or use a ~7% fixed stop; the book's examples carry 4%-7% risk.
Short filter: do not short while the stock is making new highs unless a false-breakout trigger has fired (空弱不空强).
Margin/chip filter: (price up & short interest up) = squeeze risk; (price down & short interest up after distribution) = bearish confirmation; falling broker inventory balance = distribution.
ambiguities: The upside measured move in the 正峰新 weekly example adds (H1-L1) to the pullback low L2 (24.85), not to the breakout level; the downside cases subtract from the rebound high H2. Which anchor (pullback extreme vs. breakout/neckline) applies is not consistent across chapters.

正峰新 short: the book shorts at 52.8 when the 6/2 long-red low is broken, but computes the target from the neckline break at 36.5 on 7/13 (a later event); the trigger for computing the target isn't defined.
晟铭电: the stop is set at the 'breakout neckline' ~61.5 while the short is ~58.8, giving ~4.6% by arithmetic; the book says ~6%. The 58% profit also doesn't match exactly (58.8→23.4 ≈ 60%).
晟铭电 top: 65 vs. 66.5 (unadjusted vs. dividend-adjusted); the target uses 66.5.
'Within 3 days' is how both 正峰新 and 晶电 confirm, but it isn't stated as a general rule.
微软 monthly: the stop and target for the 破底翻 re-entry are not given.
'约26倍' for 2.2→59.97 is a ~26x gain (≈27x the price).

正峰新 weekly chart: the top label (~58.20) and the final low (~7.20) are hard to read; the leftmost low ~13.52 is uncertain.
晟铭电 daily chart: the target box label near 跌幅满足 and the final lows (~27.05/23.55) are low-resolution.
晶电 daily chart: the lows marked near 84.22 / 90.26 / 90.50 are uncertain; the dashed target-box labels are unreadable.
